exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Planning Grandma's Party
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mum: Children, come here. I have some exciting news to tell you.
Adam: What is it, Mum?
Mum: I called Grandma yesterday and invited her over this Sunday. We are throwing her a big birthday party!
Sally: Wonderful! So we each need to choose a present, right?
Mum: Exactly. Have you thought of anything yet?
Adam: I'll give her a new tea set, because she loves drinking tea.
Sally: And I'm going to make her a warm scarf by hand.
Mum: Lovely ideas. Your dad has already finished the guest list, so now we just need to prepare the food.
exercises.translation_cn: 妈妈叫孩子们过来,说有好消息;她昨天打电话邀请奶奶周日过来,要给她办盛大生日派对;大家各自选礼物;Adam 要送一套茶具,因为奶奶爱喝茶;Sally 要亲手织一条暖围巾;爸爸已写好宾客名单,现在只需准备食物。

questions.stem: Who is coming to the house on Sunday?
What are they planning for Grandma?
What will Adam give Grandma?
What is Sally going to make?
What has Dad already finished?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 The International Day of Families
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Did you know there is a special day just for families?
The International Day of Families was set by the United Nations in 1993.
It is held on the fifteenth of May every year.
The day celebrates how important families are to people everywhere.
Each year it has a different theme, and many events are organised around the world.
exercises.translation_cn: 你知道有一个专为家庭设立的特别日子吗?国际家庭日由联合国于1993年设立;每年5月15日举行;这一天庆祝家庭对世界各地人们的重要性;每年都有不同主题,世界各地会举办许多活动。

questions.stem: Who set the International Day of Families?
In which year was the day set?
When is the day held?
What does the day celebrate?
options: The end of the school year.

questions.stem: What changes from year to year?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 A Career in Music
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Son: Dad, can we talk? I've made an important decision.
Father: Of course. What is it, son?
Son: I've decided not to go to university. I want to focus on my band and have a career in music.
Father: What? I always thought you would become a lawyer like me.
Son: I know, but I'm just not interested in law. I'd rather work in a music studio than in a court.
Father: But playing in a band is not a real job!
Son: It is, Dad. The music industry is growing fast these days.
Father: Well... let me think about it. Perhaps your grandfather is right that you could try both.
exercises.translation_cn: 儿子说有重要决定要谈;他决定不上大学,想专注乐队、从事音乐事业;父亲一直以为他会像自己一样当律师;儿子说对法律不感兴趣,宁愿在录音室工作而非法庭;父亲说玩乐队不是正经工作;儿子说音乐产业如今发展很快;父亲愿意考虑,也许爷爷说的两者兼顾是对的。

questions.stem: What has the son decided?
What does the son want to focus on?
What did the father always expect?
options: That his son would be a lawyer.
That his son would be a cook.

questions.stem: Where would the son rather work?
What does the son say about the music industry?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 How My Dad Has Changed
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Let me tell you how much my dad has changed over the years.
In his thirties, he was thin and pale, with thick red hair.
Nowadays he is well-built and tanned from working outdoors.
He has grown a beard, and strangely it is still red.
Meanwhile, the hair on his head is slowly turning grey. Time really does fly!
exercises.translation_cn: 我来说说爸爸这些年变化多大;三十多岁时他又瘦又苍白,一头浓密的红发;如今他体格健壮、因户外工作晒得黝黑;他留起了胡子,奇怪的是胡子仍是红色;而头上的头发却渐渐变灰。时间过得真快!

questions.stem: What did Dad look like in his thirties?
What colour was his hair back then?
What is Dad like nowadays?
What has Dad grown recently?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Mum's Apology
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mum: I'm so sorry I missed your school show today. I feel terrible about it.
Daughter: It's okay, Mum. I was just a little sad.
Mum: I had to stay at work because a colleague was away. I really wanted to be there.
Daughter: I understand. I know you've been very busy lately.
Mum: To make up for it, why don't we plan a day out together next week?
Daughter: That sounds great! Could we go camping?
Mum: Of course. We'll have a big meal and plenty of time to talk.
Daughter: Thank you, Mum. Saying sorry like this means a lot to me.
exercises.translation_cn: 妈妈为今天错过女儿的校园演出道歉,感到很难过;女儿说没关系,只是有点失落;妈妈解释因同事不在只好留在公司加班,其实很想到场;女儿表示理解,知道她最近很忙;妈妈提议下周一起出去玩弥补;女儿想去露营;妈妈答应,会准备大餐并好好聊聊;女儿感谢妈妈,这样的道歉对她意义重大。

questions.stem: Why is the mother sorry?
Why did she stay at work?
How does the daughter feel about her mum?
What do they plan for next week?
What does the daughter want to do on the trip?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 A Tip on Saying Sorry
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a useful tip about saying sorry to your family.
The way you stress your words can change the strength of an apology.
For example, a heartfelt 'I am truly sorry' has a far greater impact than a quick 'sorry'.
It is also important to listen and to mean what you say.
A sincere apology can bring family members closer together.
exercises.translation_cn: 这里有个向家人道歉的实用小贴士:你重读词语的方式会改变道歉的力度;比如,真诚地说'I am truly sorry'比随口一句'sorry'影响大得多;同样重要的是认真倾听、说到做到;真诚的道歉能让家人更亲近。

questions.stem: What is this tip about?
What can change the strength of an apology?
options: The way you stress your words.

questions.stem: Which has a greater impact, according to the passage?
